Discover December Events & Activities in Hanover, NH

content.text:
I found six events in Hanover, NH, all in December 2026. I only did one search, so nothing turned up for January through May 2027. The Hanover Conservancy calendar lists the Adair's Erratic trail opening as "RESCHEDULED" to November 14, which is before your window, so I left it out. Some results for "Main Street Hanover" (a Christmas Festival on November 28 and a Hot Chocolate & Cookie Stroll on December 12) are for Hanover, Pennsylvania, not New Hampshire, so I left them out too.

EVENT: Celebrate the Season and Tree Lighting, hosted by the Upper Valley Business Alliance as part of the Town of Hanover's "Home for the Holidays" series. It happens once a year on the Dartmouth Green and then across downtown Hanover.
